agyos_skill.intent: Azure Web PubSub Service SDK for Python. Use for real-time messaging, WebSocket connections, and pub/sub patterns.
agyos_skill.instructions: Real-time messaging with WebSocket connections at scale. ```bash pip install azure-messaging-webpubsubservice pip install azure-messaging-webpubsubclient ``` ```bash AZURE_WEBPUBSUB_CONNECTION_STRING=Endpoint=https://<name>.webpubsub.azure.com;AccessKey=... AZURE_WEBPUBSUB_HUB=my-hub ``` ```python from azure.messaging.webpubsubservice import WebPubSubServiceClient client = WebPubSubServiceClient.from_connection_string( connection_string=os.environ["AZURE_WEBPUBSUB_CONNECTION_STRING"], hub="my-hub" ) from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential client = WebPubSubServiceClient( endpoint="https://<name>.webpubsub.azure.com", hub="my-hub", credential=DefaultAzureCredential() ) ``` ```python token = client.get_client_access_token() print(f"URL: {token['url']}")
